notes: Single source of truth for the AERIS on-device brain (docs/AERIS_MOBILE_BRAIN_PLAN.md).
String args are SPANS: copied from what the user said ('shaam 6 baje', 'Ravi'); app code normalises them (time/duration/contact parsers already exist in aeris_remote).
Enum args are normalised values. 'implemented' = the phone app can run it today; unimplemented tools are still trained so the model learns them before the app catches up.
one_of: at least one of these args must be present. confirm: the app asks the user before executing.

tools.name: flashlight
tools.description: Turn the phone flashlight/torch on or off.

tools.name: volume
tools.description: Change the phone's media volume.

tools.name: brightness
tools.description: Change screen brightness.

tools.name: toggle_setting
tools.description: Turn a quick setting on/off (wifi, bluetooth, airplane mode, location, hotspot, do not disturb, mobile data, auto rotate, battery saver).

tools.name: open_settings
tools.description: Open a page of the phone's Settings app.

tools.name: battery_status
tools.description: Tell the battery level and whether it is charging.

tools.name: date_time
tools.description: Tell the current time, date or day of the week (here, now).

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Do arithmetic: percentages, plus, minus, times, divide, squares.

expression.description: the maths as the user said it

tools.name: set_alarm
tools.description: Set an alarm.

time.description: alarm time as said, e.g. '7 am', 'subah 6 baje'

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Start a countdown timer.

duration.description: duration as said, e.g. '5 minutes', 'aadha ghanta'

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Remind the user about something at a time.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Add an event/meeting to the calendar.

tools.name: call
tools.description: Phone call (or WhatsApp call) a contact or a number.

contact.description: contact name or relation as said

app.description: only if the user named it

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a contact or number (WhatsApp, SMS or Telegram).

contact.description: contact name or relation as said

message.description: the message text, exactly as dictated

app.description: only if the user named it

tools.name: open_chat
tools.description: Open a contact's chat without sending anything.

app.description: only if the user named it

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Write and send an email.

to.description: recipient name or address as said

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open an installed app.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search Google or YouTube and show the results.

tools.name: play_music
tools.description: Play music: a song, artist, genre or playlist.

query.description: song / artist / genre as said; omit for 'play some music'

app.description: only if the user named it

tools.name: media_control
tools.description: Control what is playing: play, pause, next, previous, stop.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot.

tools.name: navigate_phone
tools.description: System navigation: back, home, recent apps, notifications, quick settings, lock screen.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the current screen.

tools.name: read_screen
tools.description: Read out the text on the current screen.

tools.name: summarize_screen
tools.description: Summarise / explain what is on the current screen.

tools.name: tap_on
tools.description: Tap a button or element on the current screen by its text.

tools.name: camera
tools.description: Open the camera.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Directions / navigation to a place in maps, or show a place on the map.

mode.description: only if the user said how

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a personal fact the user wants AERIS to remember.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Look up something the user asked AERIS to remember earlier.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a remembered fact.

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate text into another language.

tools.name: laptop_command
tools.description: Run a command on the user's linked laptop (anything said with 'on the laptop / laptop pe / PC pe').

command.description: the command for the laptop, without the 'on the laptop' part

tools.name: set_language
tools.description: Switch AERIS's conversation language.

tools.name: end_conversation
tools.description: End the voice conversation (bye) or put AERIS to sleep (also stops the wake word).

mode.description: bye = close the session; sleep = also stop listening for the wake word

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Stop the task AERIS is currently doing.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Save a quick note.
